run_transform_tree: run the rostf module to create a transform tree and look up composed transforms between frames
create_transform_tree: create a TransformTree instance that wraps a tf2_ros BufferCore with a 10-second cache duration
set_transform: set a transform between two ROS frames using translation and rotation data from a dictionary
lookup_transform: lookup the composed transform between two frames in the transform tree at a given timestamp
review_transform_tree_class: review the TransformTree class and its set_transform and lookup_transform methods for ROS frame management
